svg.title: Rosette Garden — 03
svg.desc: A single structural refinement of Rosette Garden 02: linked central arches, eight continuous botanical stems, a shared scalloped flower band with alternating rosettes, and broad border lens stitches. Historical source-derived acanthus and crown vocabulary retained. Full composition has fourfold rotational symmetry. See rosette-garden-03.provenance.json. Fixed editable artwork, not a generator.
